task_title: Live DuckBrain arm aborts 72 tests at setup with 503 SERIALIZER_LOCKED instead of classifying concurrent-writer contention
task_criteria: A 503 whose body carries code SERIALIZER_LOCKED on a live write is classified as environment contention: auger.py raises a typed SubstrateLockContended (SystemExit subclass) from insert/patch/delete_row/insert_decision/insert_edge and the pytest harness converts it into an attributed skip naming the lock and namespace, instead of SystemExit aborting fixture setup; every other 503 (auth, validation, unknown or missing code, non-dict body) and a non-503 status carrying the lock code still fails loudly as plain SystemExit, asserted by committed mapping tests red-proven against the pre-fix tree; with no competing writer the full gate ends GATE PASS with the same test count and live arms ran; the pytest summary attributes the skipped tests to the lock rather than collapsing one environment fault into a battery-wide error count.

items.criterion: A 503 whose body carries code SERIALIZER_LOCKED on a live write is classified as environment contention: auger.py raises a typed SubstrateLockContended (SystemExit subclass) from insert/patch/delete_row/insert_decision/insert_edge and the pytest harness converts it into an attributed skip naming the lock and namespace, instead of SystemExit aborting fixture setup; every other 503 (auth, validation, unknown or missing code, non-dict body) and a non-503 status carrying the lock code still fails loudly as plain SystemExit, asserted by committed mapping tests red-proven against the pre-fix tree; with no competing writer the full gate ends GATE PASS with the same test count and live arms ran; the pytest summary attributes the skipped tests to the lock rather than collapsing one environment fault into a battery-wide error count.
items.detail: All legs verified with fresh commands at HEAD 3529dd7. (1) Typed raise from all five write surfaces: classifier _lock_contention auger.py:819-837 (status==503 AND dict body AND code==SERIALIZER_LOCKED, else None); class SubstrateLockContended(SystemExit) auger.py:840; wired at auger.py:866-872 insert, 878-884 patch, 999-1005 delete_row, 1311-1313 insert_edge, 5273-5277 insert_decision. (2) Harness conversion tests/conftest.py:106-110: run_cli catches ONLY auger.SubstrateLockContended -> pytest.skip('substrate write contention (503 SERIALIZER_LOCKED, AUG-209): {exc}') where the exception text names the locked namespace; plain SystemExit propagates. (3) Fail-closed asserted: tests/test_auger.py:2583-2620 parametrized auth/validation/no-code/unknown-code/non-dict 503s + :2622-2632 the 500-with-lock-code all demand a plain SystemExit that is NOT the subclass; classifier returns None for each (auger.py:828-834). (4) Red-proof independently reproduced: worktree at pre-fix base 26b67b1 with the new test files -> '8 failed, 337 deselected' with AttributeError: module 'auger' has no attribute 'SubstrateLockContended'; identical selection at HEAD -> '8 passed, 337 deselected in 0.14s'. (5) Un-contended gate: tier-1 tests output '883 passed, 3 skipped in 1536.93s', 'LIVE ARMS: ran 2; skipped 0', 'GATE PASS'; count parity: pre-fix tree collects 908 tests vs 916 at HEAD (883+3+30 jev-marker-deselected), delta = exactly the 8 new mapping tests; gate.sh:460-471 plain GATE PASS (not DEGRADED) requires zero skipped arms. (6) Attribution: the skip itself carries the committed reason naming AUG-209 + SERIALIZER_LOCKED + namespace (asserted by test_run_cli_converts_the_typed_contention_into_a_named_skip, tests/test_auger.py:2634-2665); one lock event yields attributed SKIPPED lines, never the pre-fix ERROR-at-setup storm. Documented nuance: the FULL gate branch logs only 'N skipped' (tests/gate.sh:297 passes -q without -ra; verified experimentally that -q alone prints no reason and -q -ra prints 'SKIPPED [1] ... substrate write contention (503 SERIALIZER_LOCKED, AUG-209)...', as does the hosted-CI branch gate.sh:294) — the attribution surface exists and is asserted in code; only the FULL-gate log omits the per-skip reason lines.

items.criterion: Back-compat: every existing composite 'except SystemExit' write path keeps exact pre-fix behaviour (SubstrateLockContended subclasses SystemExit on purpose)
items.detail: auger.py:840 'class SubstrateLockContended(SystemExit)' with docstring stating composite paths keep pre-fix semantics; fresh run at HEAD: pytest -k 'refused_advance or rewrite_restores or puts_the_question_row_back or patch_or_rewrite or advance_domain' -> '3 passed, 342 deselected in 6.99s' including the pre-existing test_a_refused_advance_warns_once_and_costs_nothing (tests/test_auger.py:9603); LSP diagnostics 0; full tier-1 gate green (883 passed / 3 skipped).

items.criterion: Harness seam reachability: the skip conversion fires from the fixture-setup path the task title describes (ns/project/answer fixtures)
items.detail: tests/conftest.py:92-110: run_cli is the single seam and it is what the ns fixture (:974 'run_cli(["-n", ns_created, "init"])'), the project fixture (:993) and the answer helper (:1030) call; a 503 SERIALIZER_LOCKED raised by auger.main during setup becomes pytest.skip at exactly that point instead of an ERROR, matching the merge-message reproduction (pre-fix 41 failed + 79 ERROR-at-setup -> post-fix 119 attributed skips, zero setup errors).
